_source: In-game Reputation > Quests screenshots. Liyue 30 Oct 2026, Inazuma 7 Nov 2026. Only quests showing 'Claimed' are listed. This is the one fact no API exposes - progress is server-side - so it has to be transcribed by hand.
_names: Entries use the WIKI title, not the in-game row, where the two differ. The game shows 'Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual: Yougou Cleansing'; the wiki page is 'Yougou Cleansing'. _partial: The Inazuma capture is two screenshots at different scroll positions, so rows between or below them may be missing. Treat the Inazuma list as a floor, not a complete count.
